title: Yokai Pop Font
author: HipFonts
description:
Give your next design the charm of a record worth keeping.
Yokai Pop is a vintage Japanese-inspired display typeface that channels the expressive spirit of 1970s vinyl covers. Think carefully composed record sleeves, unexpected color combinations, and lettering that makes you curious about the music before the needle touches the groove. Nostalgic, playful, and full of personality, Yokai Pop brings that same sense of discovery to modern design.
Inspired by an era when album artwork was part of the listening experience, Yokai Pop turns a title into the main attraction. Pair it with warm paper textures and faded tones for a treasured-record feel, or introduce vivid colors and clean layouts to give its vintage character a fresh setting. It invites you to build compositions with rhythm, atmosphere, and a little imagination.
Use it for album covers, music posters, distinctive logos, boutique packaging, magazine headlines, apparel, café identities, and record-store branding. Whether you’re creating a fictional record label or giving a contemporary brand a nostalgic voice, Yokai Pop helps your typography become part of the story.
A little vinyl nostalgia. A little Japanese pop. A whole lot of character.

To elevate your design, pair the Nagoya font with a minimalist monolinear sans-serif to create a striking contrast between the headline and body text. With balanced proportions and sharp details, Nagoya provides excellent legibility while maintaining a distinctive modern style. Supported by multilingual characters, it is built for global creative use.

author: Yumnacreative

title: Jawara Font
author: artstoreid
description: Jawara is an experimental condensed display typeface inspired by the visual rhythm and ornamental character of ancient Javanese script. Perfect for branding, posters, packaging, music artwork, and cultural projects.

title: Kurohe Otf Font

Its bold strokes and distinctive character shapes make it an ideal choice for projects that demand presence and originality. Whether you’re crafting logos, branding materials, posters, or streetwear graphics, Kurohe adds a fearless, creative edge.
This font is 100% free for both personal and commercial use. Attribution is not required, though credit is always appreciated if you’d like to support the artist.
